entry_points.text: Extended dispatch selects later symbol sources; debugger drain, match, fanout and completion serve interactive work.

Emergency acquire builds a zeroed context; kdb release leaves unsafe then flushes; globals expose priority, takeover check, reserve seq, console lock/unlock, panic flush, atomic flush, percpu readiness and validity.

exports.text: Core, module and probe lookups are globally visible; core maps index to address, module maps a global number, probe consumes one count per cache page then an arch hook that always reports absence.
Printk exposes oldest sequence, console sequence expansion, buffer attach, next-message fetch with formatting, and dropped/replay banner prepend.
Panic predicates report if current CPU is panicking, if panic runs elsewhere, and if any panic is active.

hazards.text: Expansion and prefixing may truncate with termination only when room remains; racy reads use size checks, retry and tail catch-up; atomic flush never waits for unfinalized; panic flush bypasses locks and may emit while unsafe.

Fanout assumes stopped CPUs and reentry tolerance, skipping unacquired consoles; drain polls until quiet and can stall; unsafe takeover sticks with racy drops and handover fails after; waiting forbids panic elsewhere, same-CPU or zero budget with warnings.

invariants.text: Builtin names use a short header; expansion decodes via tables, drops first char as type, honors capacity; type reads from opening token; core step clears module label then expands name.
Beyond core, walks modules, tracer, bpf then probes with relative positions and sticky ends; skips unformed modules; export check searches the right table and confirms address equality.
Completion keeps a persistent position reset on fresh search and returns first prefix match; line match ignores trailing newline with anchor options; clearing removes a named flag.

Acquire tries direct, handover with bounded poll, then hostile; direct refuses panic elsewhere, low priority or unsafe; waiter needs matching request and no owner; hostile needs panic priority and allowance; default prefers panic, emergency, normal; nesting uses early global then percpu.

Narrow sequences expand via helpers; publication uses compare-exchange on truncated words with two builds; next reserve derives from last finalized plus head distance with retry and a never-finalized case.

Ids mask to index; packed state splits identity and selector, mismatch means recycled; validation separates missing, lost, usable; reads resolve, check finalized, copy then revalidate; validity catches up or skips lost; blocks accept single or once-wrapping extents with checks; copy honors capacity.

Record text clamps length, builds one prefix and prepends per line in place; prefix joins syslog, time and caller; caller and exec context have active and empty builds; pid/cpu select by flag; extended headers carry level, seq, time with escaping and dict lines; suppression honors loglevel unless overridden.

Panic flush ignores locks, clears scheduling, optionally rewinds, runs atomic then legacy sync; type prefers offload in normal, atomic in emergency, never offloads in panic; atomic walk skips caught-up consoles and stops on new ownership or unfinalized.

locks.text: Module walk uses RCU guard; probe walk holds read lock; kdb fanout samples flags under sleepable read lock; flush walk uses NMI-safe SRCU; seq computation relies on acquire ordering.

State changes only via compare-exchange retry; ownership needs matching priority and CPU plus driver lock when migratable; owner continues alone or in unsafe else releases preserving takeover-unsafe; unsafe toggles via helper; descriptor reads use ordered loads.

state_machines.text: Kallsyms stays in one source until exhaustion then skips it; nbcon moves from handover to hostile unless refused; waiter install is atomic; hostile merges unsafe markers.

Inconsistent observations return early while only finalized or reusable are accepted; validation separates absent, lost, usable; atomic flush emits one record per cycle handling loss, retry and unfinalized; single emit merges drops, detects replay and updates seq in unsafe.

structs.text: Iterator holds position, offsets, value, buffers and sticky ends; bpf and probe use fixed labels with cleared export; probe uses type t; capacities are fixed; emergency priority is used and request clears to none; write context holds buffer and marker; ownership packs fields atomically; message carries seq and gaps; read handle holds pointers.

Descriptors and info share a masked index; packed state splits identity low with shifted selector; syslog combines facility shifted by three with level; time splits nanos by one billion; caller uses top bit as selector.
